about: Stories surfaced by the sources card between 13 and 17 November 2026, judged by hand against docs/scoring.md. This is a manual run, not the agent: the prompt was not used to produce these verdicts.

sources.eurekalert_ai_spotlight: 56 releases dated in the window, 33 of them mentioning AI. Read from the web page, since no RSS address could be found.
sources.google_news_searches: 4 searches (health outcomes, nature and rescue, accessibility and space, general AI), about 160 headlines.
sources.good_news_network: 50 posts in the feed, 1 in the window that mentions robots, none where AI is the story.
sources.reasons_to_be_cheerful: 10 posts in the feed, none about AI.
sources.positive_news: Feed blocked the request (403), so not covered.
sources.not_covered: NHS, NIHR, Moorfields, NASA, ESA, Met Office, Wellcome and conservation charities were not checked directly, and there were no audience submissions.

stories.title: New AI warning system for flooding to be rolled out in Dublin
stories.line: Dublin is switching on an AI flood warning this week. In tests on past storms it spotted some floods 13 to 21 hours ahead.
stories.note: Borderline on the 'it happened' gate: the pilot starts this week and the 13 to 21 hours comes from tests on historical events, as reported by the supplier. No live warning has been issued yet.

stories.title: AI may help tailor treatment for childhood brain tumors
stories.source: Dana-Farber release on EurekAlert (Nature Genetics), picked up by Harvard on 16 Nov
stories.line: Doctors built an AI that predicts how a child's brain tumour will go, better than today's methods. The aim is gentler treatment.
stories.checked: Read the release in full. The journal paper itself was not opened.
stories.note: The release is dated 3 November and surfaced in the news search on 16 November.

stories.title: Novel algorithm predicts brain surgery outcomes in dystonia patients
stories.source: Mass General Brigham release on EurekAlert (npj Digital Medicine)
stories.line: An AI can read a brain scan and tell which people with dystonia are likely to benefit from brain surgery, before anyone operates.
stories.checked: Read the release in full. The journal paper itself was not opened.

stories.title: OpenAI sued by California over Hugging Face attack
stories.line: California is taking OpenAI to court after its test agents hacked another company. Scary story, but someone is holding AI labs to account.
stories.note: For a flip the last score is how well known the bad story is. The stage tag fits flips badly, see the findings.

stories.title: Malawian innovator uses AI to improve learning for blind students
stories.source: TVC News, Al Jazeera short; D+C feature
stories.reason: Strong story with a named pupil whose grades improved, but it has been public since at least March 2026. Best candidate for the evergreen bank.

stories.title: AI made a visual-cortex implant more precise in one blind man
stories.reason: The study was published in early August 2026, just over 90 days ago. One participant, and it did not restore sight.
stories.checked: Search summary of the university announcement only.

stories.title: NHS trials AI phone assistant for patients with long-term illness
stories.reason: A two-year trial is starting for people with osteoporosis. There are no results yet.

stories.title: Khushi chatbot uses BharatGPT to help TB patients find care
stories.reason: Could not open the article or an official page with a launch date. Search results disagree on details such as 12 or 15 languages.

stories.title: Prince William and Kate back teen's wildfire breakthrough
stories.reason: No other report of this could be found.

stories.title: SNU's STARLINC AI filters Starlink trails from telescope data
stories.reason: Preprint only.
stories.checked: Search result shows an arXiv preprint.

stories.title: KAIST develops lip-reading AI
stories.reason: The release links to an arXiv preprint, and the benefit for deaf people is described as expected, not shown.

stories.title: Machine-learning models accurately predict mortality after a heart attack
stories.source: European Society of Cardiology release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: Conference presentation, not peer-reviewed. The release says studies are still needed to see if it helps patients.

stories.title: Older AI-estimated heart age linked with cardiovascular and dementia death
stories.source: European Society of Cardiology release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: Conference presentation, and it reports an association, not a benefit to anyone.

stories.title: Mobile app and telemonitoring improves quality of life in heart failure
stories.source: European Society of Cardiology release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: A telemonitoring programme run by specialists. AI is not what made the difference.

stories.title: Telehealth assessment of infant development reliable
stories.source: UC Davis Health release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: A video-call assessment tool. No AI involved.

stories.title: Tokyo tackles trash troubles with robotic street waste bins
stories.reason: Solar-powered compacting bins and robots. AI is not the reason for the story.

stories.title: Opening the datasets behind our AI weather models
stories.reason: A dataset release for researchers, from a company blog with no independent source.

stories.title: Upside-down atomic layers could steer heat in stacked computer chips
stories.source: University of Tokyo release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: Can't be said plainly in 140 characters, and nothing has changed outside the lab.

stories.title: Loughborough researcher awarded Turing AI Fellowship to transform flood forecasting
stories.reason: A grant award. Nothing has happened yet.

stories.title: One NZ launches fund to back AI-powered conservation projects
stories.reason: A fund launch. No project has delivered anything yet.

stories.title: AI discovers a hidden heart signal that could predict sudden death
stories.reason: Headline is a 'could'.

stories.title: AI startup Tom Health cuts ER trips by 28%
stories.reason: A company's own claim. No independent source found.

stories.title: AI scraper bots are overwhelming research library collections
stories.reason: The CBC report could not be opened. The good side is real (four AI companies backed a shared opt-out signal on 30 October), but coverage says it is voluntary and does not cover the third-party bots causing the problem, so it would also fail 'doesn't shrink the harm'.
stories.checked: Read the Editor and Publisher piece on the opt-out. The CBC story only through summaries.

stories.title: Google flags first autonomous AI cyberattack
stories.reason: Could not find the November report. Search results point to a similar Google report from May 2026. If confirmed, 'Google stopped it before any damage' would be a strong flip.

stories.title: AI advances coincide with sharp rise in cyber incidents, Marsh data shows
stories.reason: Could not find the article or the Marsh data behind it.

stories.title: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material rise 8,400% in two years
stories.reason: Child abuse. Never flipped.

stories.title: Hyperscale data centres use as much electricity as US states
stories.reason: No documented good side found. The study is only the measurement.

stories.title: AI systems are easy to pressure into giving false climate information
stories.reason: The report does say the best models get basic climate facts right 88% to 96% of the time, but that is not a response, a disclosure, a fix or another use of the technology.

stories.title: Deepfake faces appear hyperreal, brain scans may explain why
stories.source: University of Florida release on EurekAlert
stories.reason: No documented good side found, and the context is scams against older people.
